data.name: MUV-LUV GIRLS GARDEN Mellow Days
data.detailed_description:
Muv-Luv Girls Garden Mellow Days is a productivity companion and communication adventure game where you work through your daily tasks alongside Meru Momozono.

Studying, work, creative projects, and everyday tasks.

Even when it is hard to stay focused on your own, having Meru by your side may give you just a little more motivation to keep going.

Organize your tasks with a Pomodoro timer, ToDo list, and calendar, then settle into a workspace of your own with music and ambient sounds playing in the background.

As you spend more time working hard together, new conversations and stories with Meru will gradually unfold.

▼Work Alongside Meru Momozono

When you start a work session, Meru begins working on her own tasks in the same space as you.

While you are focused, when you are feeling a little tired, and when you finish your work—

through her expressions, animations, and voice lines, Meru stays by your side throughout every session.

▼Find the Right Balance Between Focus and Rest

The Pomodoro timer lets you freely set the length of your focus sessions, breaks, and the number of cycles.

Alternate between work and rest to make steady progress at a pace that works for you, without overdoing it.

When your session ends, Meru may even praise you for all your hard work.

▼Create a Workspace of Your Own

Mix and match music, ambient sounds, time of day, and backgrounds to create a workspace that helps you focus.

Work quietly to the sound of rain, unwind with soothing music in a nighttime room, or adjust the atmosphere to suit your mood and the task at hand.

Create a space you love and make it your everyday place to get things done.

▼The Time You Spend Together Becomes a Story

As you continue working with Meru, new conversations and story episodes will gradually unlock.

You may discover expressions she never shows while working, or feelings she does not usually talk about.

The time you spend working hard is more than just a record of the tasks you complete.

It builds into precious memories of the time you and Meru have shared.
